description: Entry point for AI Security queries, scoped to a single account.
name: aiSecurity

definition.description: Input for fetching a single end-user conversation's PSI by message id.

appId.description: Canonical id of the application the conversation belongs to.
appId.name: appId

messageId.description: Identifier of the message (conversation) to fetch. Together with sessionId this identifies the conversation uniquely.
messageId.name: messageId

sessionId.description: Identifier of the chat session the conversation belongs to.
sessionId.name: sessionId

userId.description: Optional end-user identifier. Used only to narrow the underlying lookup for performance; it does not scope the result per user — sessionId and messageId already identify the conversation uniquely, so omitting it never returns a different user's conversation.
userId.name: userId

definition.description: Root of the AI Security query namespace for an account.

invocation.description: Fetch a single invocation by its ID.
invocation.name: invocation

definition.description: A single invocation (any call to or response from an LLM) intercepted by the AI Security guard.

action.description: The enforcement outcome applied to this invocation.
action.name: action

definition.description: The enforcement outcome applied to an invocation.

enumValues.description: The request or response was blocked.
enumValues.name: BLOCK

enumValues.description: Sensitive content was masked before forwarding.
enumValues.name: ANONYMIZE

enumValues.description: No action was taken — all matched rules are in monitor mode.
enumValues.name: MONITOR

enumValues.description: No action was taken — no rules matched.
enumValues.name: NONE

data.description: Invocation messages (original, not anonymized). Caller must have AiSecurityForAppsGuardsSensitive RBAC permission.
